description_en: Sends a message to multiple recipients in countries or regions outside the Chinese mainland
description_zh: 批量发送短信到中国境外
name: BatchSendMessageToGlobe

parameters.help_en:
The mobile phone number of the recipient. You must add the dialing code to the beginning of each mobile phone number.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158400.html
parameters.help_zh:
接收方号码。号码格式为：国际区号+号码。

电话代码详情，请参见电话代码 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/short-message-service/latest/dialing-codes)
parameters.name: to

parameters.help_en: The mobile phone number of the sender. You can specify the sender ID when you call the API operation. The sender ID can contain only digits and letters. If the sender ID contains letters, it can be a maximum of 11 characters in length. If the sender ID contains only digits, it can be a maximum of 15 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 发送方号码。支持Sender ID的发送，只允许数字、字母，含有字母标识最长11位，纯数字标识支持15位
parameters.name: from

parameters.help_en:
The type of the message. Valid values:

NOTIFY: notification

MKT: promotional message
parameters.help_zh:
短信类型。取值：


NOTIFY：通知短信。

MKT：推广短信
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the messaging campaign. It must be 1 to 255 characters in length. The ID is the value of the TaskId field in the delivery receipt of the message
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID。长度不超过255个字符。可以在短信回执消息体的TaskId字段获取
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The validity period of the message. Unit: seconds
parameters.name: validity_period

parameters.help_en: The ID of the delivery channel
parameters.name: channel_id

FailedList.description_en: The list of the mobile phone numbers that failed to receive the messages

From.description_en: The sender ID that was returned. The API operation returns the sender ID that you have specified in the request parameters
From.description_zh: 发送方标识，返回传入的Sender ID
From.title_en: 发送方标识，返回传入的SenderID。
From.title_zh: 发送方标识，返回传入的SenderID。

MessageIdList.description_en: The ID of the sent message

ResponseCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. If OK is returned, the request is successful. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/180674.html）
ResponseCode.description_zh: 状态码。返回OK代表请求成功，其他错误码，请参见错误码列表 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/short-message-service/latest/error-codes)
ResponseCode.title_en: 状态码。返回OK代表请求成功，其他错误码，请参见错误码列表。
ResponseCode.title_zh: 状态码。返回OK代表请求成功，其他错误码，请参见错误码列表。
